f: Triangle Area: SAS Sine Formula & Heron's Formula
f_ar: المثلث المساحة: SAS Sine الصيغة & Heron's الصيغة
b:
SAS Area Formula: \[ \text{Area} = \frac{1}{2}ab\sin C = \frac{1}{2}bc\sin A = \frac{1}{2}ac\sin B. \]

Heron's Formula (SSS): For a triangle with side lengths \(a, b, c\) and semi-perimeter \(s = \frac{a+b+c}{2}\): \[ \text{Area} = \sqrt{s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)}. \]

b: Any linear combination of sine and cosine with identical angular frequencies can be condensed into a single phase-shifted sinusoid: \[ a\cos(\omega x) + b\sin(\omega x) = R\cos(\omega x - \phi), \] where the amplitude \(R\) and phase angle \(\phi\) are defined uniquely by \[ R = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2}, \quad \cos\phi = \frac{a}{R}, \quad \sin\phi = \frac{b}{R} \implies \phi = \text{atan2}(b, a). \]
